user.title: Select Serial Port
user.description: Choose the USB serial adapter connected to the Autoterm heater. The FTDI FT232R entry (from the VAN PI adapter) will be pre-selected if present.

manual.title: Manual Port Entry
manual.description: Enter the full path to the serial device. Use the stable /dev/serial/by-id/... form, not /dev/ttyUSBx.

data_description.temp_source_entity: HA sensor entity (e.g. DS18B20) used as the current room temperature. Fed to the heater as panel temp when Temperature Source is set to 'ha_sensor'. Can be set or changed later in Options.

error.port_not_found: Device path does not exist. Ensure the adapter is connected.

data_description.temp_source_entity: HA sensor entity whose value is fed to the heater every poll cycle when Temperature Source is set to 'ha_sensor'. Falls back to the internal sensor if unavailable.
